question: Should the bombers come back to Fairford, yes or no?
hook_lines: ALL US BOMBERS LEAVE RAF FAIRFORD
About a dozen B-1s flown home

lines.text: All US bombers have left RAF Fairford, the Pentagon says.
lines.note: Pentagon spokesperson to Al Jazeera, confirmed 4 Oct

lines.text: Flight trackers saw about a dozen B-1 bombers leave the UK on Sunday, AeroTime reports.
lines.note: AeroTime: a dozen B-1Bs seen on flight tracking websites departing 4 Oct; Al Jazeera: roughly a dozen

lines.text: Three of them landed in South Dakota.
lines.note: AeroTime: three aircraft landing in South Dakota

lines.text: The Pentagon says every bomber deployed to Fairford has gone back to its home station in the United States.
lines.note: Pentagon: 'all U.S. bombers that were deployed to RAF Fairford have re-deployed to their home stations in the United States.'

scene.quote: re-deployed to their home stations in the United States

lines.text: It says operational security stopped it confirming the move in real time.
lines.note: Pentagon: 'operational security precluded us from confirming the movement of our assets and forces in real-time'

lines.text: CNN and The New York Times report the move followed new threats against the base.
lines.note: CNN headline: 'US removes all Air Force bombers from UK base following new threat'; NYT: 'U.S. Rushes to Withdraw Bombers From U.K. Air Base After New Threats'

lines.text: Fairford is about 160 kilometres west of London.
Britain approved specific defensive operations into Iran from the base in March, Euronews says.
lines.note: Euronews: Britain granted permission in March 2026 for 'specific defensive operations into Iran'

lines.text: It is the only airbase on mainland Britain used for that.
lines.note: Euronews: 'the only airbase on Britain's mainland used for this purpose'

lines.text: Last month, police arrested several men near Fairford, and counter-terrorism officers are investigating.
lines.note: CBS, Euronews: arrests 27 Sep, counter-terrorism police investigation; no names, no nationalities used

lines.text: CBS News says petrol was found, but no explosives, and the suspects are on bail.
lines.note: CBS: gasoline in three vans, no explosives discovered, all suspects released on bail

lines.text: The Pentagon says US bombers routinely operate around the world.
lines.note: CBS: 'U.S. Air Force bombers routinely operate around the world to support global force readiness and operational requirements.'

scene.quote: bombers routinely operate around the world

lines.text: For now, Fairford has no US bombers. Should they come back, yes or no?

caption: RAF Fairford: the Pentagon says all US bombers deployed to the Gloucestershire base have flown home to the United States, and flight trackers saw about a dozen B-1s leave. CNN and The New York Times report new threats against the base. Should the bombers come back, yes or no?
